description: This file defines the CKEditor plugin for handling indent and outdent commands, including their logic, UI buttons, and configuration options.

classes.name: indentCommand
classes.description: Class representing the indent/outdent command with execution logic.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the state of the command (enabled, disabled, off).

methods.name: onSelectionChange
methods.description: Handles changes in selection to update command state.

methods.name: indentCommand
methods.description: Constructor for the indentCommand class, initializes command properties.

methods.name: getIndentCssProperty
methods.description: Returns the CSS property ('margin-left' or 'margin-right') used for indentation based on direction.

methods.name: isListItem
methods.description: Checks if a node is a list item ('li').

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the indent or outdent operation on the selected content.
